Name: StarAmy's Bakery Displays 1.6 for FDF
Author: Ashrayne
Description:
[i][size=4]Presenting: StarAmy's [/size][/i][size=4][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14229/]Bakery Displays[/url] , now updated to CP &  AT for full compatibility with SDV 1.6.

Features:[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]15 functional wall or freestanding shelves and bakery display cases purchasable from Robin's shop. 
[*]The freestanding pieces can be placed both indoors and outdoors.
[*]Up to nine objects can be placed on the shelves using Furniture Display Framework (FDF)
[*]Access all six original StarAmy sprite recolors for each piece using Alternative Textures
[*]Access this mod's furniture set from StarAmy's furniture catalogue if you have that installed (see optional mod requirements)
[/list]
[size=4][i]Recommended Pairings:[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]Create even more beautiful & elaborate farmers' market/restaurant designs with StarAmy's display cases in tandem with Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18814/]H&W's Farmer's Market Furniture Suite[/url] (pictured in the screenshots), also available in 3 recolors for your designing pleasure.
[*]Transform StarAmy's beautiful display cases into the centerpiece of your very own fully functional store or restaurant with HaPyke's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309/]Market Town[/url]
[/list]
[i][size=4]Known Bugs/Limitations:[/size][/i]
[list]
[*]Placing modded objects on the shelves currently causes the object to appear with an incorrect sprite. I've pinged Ilyeana (who updated FDF for 1.6), and hopefully she can fix that soon.
[*]Sadly, these shelves are purely decorative at the moment as Market Town does not recognize objects placed on them for sale despite their being categorized as tables. Perhaps this can be corrected? A question for HaPyke!
[/list]
Um, please don't ask me hard technical questions! I'm literally a player with no prior modding experience, who gamely spent the last week trolling the SDV wiki and Discord strugglebusing through putting this together so that I can continue to use one of my favorite furniture mods in SDV 1.6. Again, all credit belongs to StarAmy, and her generous permission which allows me to share the miraculous result of my arduous foray into modding with you all. :)

Downloads.Description: Download and extract into your Stardew Mods folder, along with all requirements. If you have StarAmy's furniture catalogue installed, this furniture set will appear in her catalogue instead of Robin's shop.
